decisions.note: Skill ID 111602211 is verified as JP 最強淑女の誇り; the title is compositional and the Vietnamese rendering preserves both 最強 and 淑女 without relying on the Chinese wording for a proper name.
Skill ID 202451 verifies JP トップギア. Normalize the Chinese semantic rendering back to the stable loan-title Top Gear, consistent with registry treatment of clear katakana/Latin skill titles.
Skill ID 201453 is verified as JP 月影一閃, but its compact poetic title admits multiple Vietnamese renderings; no repository convention resolves the wording.
Skill ID 201463 is verified as JP 月影円刃, but the poetic compound has multiple plausible Vietnamese title renderings and lacks a repository precedent.
Skill ID 108402211 verifies JP アルテミスの矢. Use the proper name Artemis explicitly rather than calquing the Chinese generic 'moon goddess' wording.
Skill ID 204302 is verified as JP 個性的, but both 'Cá tính' and 'Độc đáo' are viable Vietnamese title choices; repository evidence does not select one.
